verdict.rationale: Wise's site explicitly says you can "lock in exactly what your recipient will get for up to 24 hours," so you are protected if the rate drops. That directly matches locking a rate for a fixed window before completing a transfer. The evidence is a single marketing line, though, with no detail on how this works for business accounts or via the API. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on rate-lock mechanics (quote expiry, conditions, Business/API applicability), independent or hands-on corroboration.
